const retentionSourceCaughtUp = `-- name: RetentionSourceCaughtUp :one
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM retention_checkpoint c LEFT JOIN retention_catchup j ON j.checkpoint_id=c.id
 WHERE c.root_id=$1 AND c.cluster_id=$2 AND c.namespace_uid=$3
 AND (c.audit_acknowledged_at IS NULL OR j.checkpoint_id IS NULL OR j.completed_at IS NULL
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retention_catchup_effect e JOIN retention_decision d ON d.id=e.decision_id
 WHERE e.checkpoint_id=c.id AND (d.audit_acknowledged_at IS NULL OR d.root_id<>c.root_id OR d.attempt_id<>e.attempt_id)))
) AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM retention_checkpoint c
 WHERE c.root_id=$1 AND c.cluster_id=$2 AND c.namespace_uid=$3
 AND (c.audit_acknowledged_at IS NULL OR NOT public.retention_checkpoint_receipt_current(c.root_id,c.id,c.audit_receipt))
) AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM retention_decision d
 JOIN retention_catchup_effect e ON e.decision_id=d.id
 JOIN retention_checkpoint c ON c.id=e.checkpoint_id
 WHERE d.root_id=$1
 AND (d.audit_acknowledged_at IS NULL OR NOT public.retention_lifecycle_receipt_current(d.root_id,d.id,d.audit_receipt_json))
 AND c.root_id=$1 AND c.cluster_id=$2 AND c.namespace_uid=$3
) AS complete
`

type RetentionSourceCaughtUpParams struct {
	RootID       pgtype.UUID
	ClusterID    pgtype.UUID
	NamespaceUid string
}

func (q *Queries) RetentionSourceCaughtUp(ctx context.Context, arg RetentionSourceCaughtUpParams) (pgtype.Bool, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, retentionSourceCaughtUp, arg.RootID, arg.ClusterID, arg.NamespaceUid)
	var complete pgtype.Bool
	err := row.Scan(&complete)
	return complete, err
}
